nodes.label: migrate-skill-pack skill
nodes.rationale: Transforms bare SKILL.md folders into lazy-loaded, structured skill packs discoverable by the SDK

nodes.label: skill-plugins directory
nodes.rationale: Location where skill packs live under data/, scanned at session start by discoverSkillPluginInfo()

nodes.label: discoverSkillPluginInfo() function
nodes.rationale: SDK function that scans data/skill-plugins/* for .claude-plugin/plugin.json or marketplace.json manifests; skips unmanifested dirs

nodes.label: .claude-plugin/ manifest directory
nodes.rationale: Required directory structure for SDK discovery; contains plugin.json or marketplace.json

nodes.label: marketplace.json manifest
nodes.rationale: Plugin manifest file defining pack name, description, version, plugins array, and skills paths

nodes.label: lazyLoad config property
nodes.rationale: Boolean flag that excludes packs from SDK session-start plugin set; lazy packs load on-demand via load_skill()

nodes.label: skillPlugins registry
nodes.rationale: config.json section mapping pack names to metadata (lazyLoad, description) for SDK discovery

nodes.label: applauz-policies skill pack
nodes.rationale: Reference implementation for lazy-loaded skill pack structure and config.json registry entry

nodes.label: applauz-insurance skill pack
nodes.rationale: Example bare skill pack that needs migration to lazy-loaded structure

nodes.label: config.json
nodes.rationale: Main runtime config file where skillPlugins registry entries are defined

nodes.label: SKILL.md
nodes.rationale: Skill definition file with YAML frontmatter containing 'name' and markdown description; moves to skills/<name>/SKILL.md in migration

nodes.label: load_skill() function
nodes.rationale: Claude-callable function to load a skill on-demand from a lazy pack; syntax load_skill('<pack>', '<skill>')

nodes.label: data/.deploy-include
nodes.rationale: Deployment manifest listing which paths under data/ get pushed to GCE VM via gce-push-config.sh

nodes.label: gce-push-config.sh script
nodes.rationale: Deployment script that pushes config.json and mcp.json to GCE VM using data/.deploy-include manifest; non-interactive diff guard

nodes.label: migration 018: lazy-skill-references
nodes.rationale: Historical migration that rewrote instruction file references from Skill('<name>') to load_skill('<pack>', '<name>')

nodes.label: data/configuration/ overrides
nodes.rationale: User-editable instruction file overrides that may reference skills; gitignored and take precedence over defaults

nodes.label: pre-commit hook
nodes.rationale: Lefthook pre-commit hook that runs in parallel: linting (oxlint), formatting (oxfmt), and tests (npm test) on staged files

nodes.label: oxlint linter
nodes.rationale: TypeScript/JavaScript linter run by pre-commit hook on *.{ts,js} staged files; enforces code quality rules

nodes.label: oxfmt formatter
nodes.rationale: Code formatter run by pre-commit hook in check mode on *.{ts,js,json} staged files (excluding graphify-out/**)

nodes.label: npm test command
nodes.rationale: Test runner executed by pre-commit hook on all staged *.ts files; must pass for commit to succeed

nodes.label: graphify-out/ exclusion
nodes.rationale: graphify-out/** is excluded from oxfmt formatting checks in pre-commit hook
